answer: Per Connapse memory (checkout-team space, from ADR-007), checkout sessions are stored in Redis 7 with a 30-minute TTL. They moved there from the ledger PostgreSQL database on 2026-09-14, after the September sale incident where session writes were slowing charge inserts. The tradeoff is that a Redis restart logs shoppers out of checkout, though carts survive in the storefront.
